verses.translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
And I swear by the reproaching soul[1800] [to the certainty of resurrection].
verses.footnotes: [1800]- i.e., that of the believer, which blames him when he falls into sin or error.

verses.translation: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
verses.translation: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
But man desires to continue in sin.[1801]
verses.footnotes: [1801]- Literally, "to sin ahead of him." This refers to the disbeliever, who denies the Day of Account.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to intend, to desire, to want, to wish

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: So when vision is dazzled

segments.gloss: to be dazzled, to be frightened

verses.translation: And the moon darkens
And the sun and the moon are joined,

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: No! There is no refuge.
To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

verses.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
verses.translation: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead[1802] and kept back.[1803]
verses.footnotes:
[1802]- i.e., his deeds, which await him in the Hereafter.
[1803]- i.e., that which he did not do or which he delayed.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,[1804]
Even if he presents his excuses.

segments.gloss: to cast, to throw, to meet, to offer

verses.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
verses.translation: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
Looking at their Lord.[1805]
verses.footnotes: [1805]- The people of Paradise will actually see their Creator in the Hereafter.

verses.translation: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
segments.gloss: to think, to assume, to guess

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones[1806]
verses.footnotes: [1806]- At the time it is about to leave the body when one is on the verge of death.

verses.translation: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation

segments.gloss: to think, to assume, to guess

verses.translation: And the leg is wound about the leg,[1807]
verses.footnotes: [1807]- From the difficulties the person faces at death or his sudden awareness of the realities of both this world and the Hereafter. It may also refer to his shrouding after death.

verses.translation: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.[1808]
verses.footnotes: [1808]- Literally, "driving" or "herding" or "the place to which one is driven."

verses.translation: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.

segments.gloss: to accept truth, to admit, to confirm, to believe

verses.translation: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Woe to you, and woe!
Then woe to you, and woe!
Does man think that he will be left neglected?[1809]
verses.footnotes: [1809]- i.e., to no end, without responsibility, or without being returned to the Creator for judgement.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
verses.translation: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
verses.translation: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
